# ADR-0002 — Engineering-spec reconciliation (contradictions + OPEN defaults)

Status: Accepted · Date: 2026-08-17 · Slice: pre-S0 (spec freeze) · Kind: reconciliation

## Context
Docs 00–05 were authored in parallel from the same sources; the whole-set critic found ~20 cross-doc contradictions and ~80 OPEN items with proposed defaults. This ADR settles them **once**; every doc is amended to match (this PR). Precedence used: product decisions in `docs/spec.md`/`questions.md`/`DESIGN.md`/`data-model.md`/`notifications.md` win over any spec doc; among 00–05, **04 owns names/shapes**, **03 owns component names + S/C**, **02 owns route rendering**, **data-model owns RLS**. Items marked **[DAVID — confirmed 2026-08-17]** were flagged for David and confirmed verbatim: moderators moderate comments only and never touch content; no About page in v1; `users` metric is a daily aggregate count only.

## Decisions — contradictions (critic §c)
| # | Topic | Decision (all docs align to this) |
|---|---|---|
| C1 | Session-aware UI on ISR pages | **Client seam.** `ViewerProvider` (client, in `app/(public)/layout.tsx`) + `CommentThread` (client) read only the viewer's own rows via `lib/supabase/client.ts` under RLS. **No PPR, no `experimental.*`.** Public comments come server-side via `lib/data/comments.ts` + view `comments_public` (tag `project:<slug>`); own held/hidden + own likes read client-side. Drop `NavSession`/`Nav.Viewer`/`CommentThreadSection`. |
| C2 | `/admin/settings` | Whole route in **S1.5** (incl. `setUserRole`, moderators table). Until then, roles are bootstrapped by SQL (seed locally; one documented SQL for prod after first sign-in). S1.1 has no settings stub. |
| C3 | Sign-in entry | **Client-side** `GoogleSignInButton` → `supabase.auth.signInWithOAuth({provider:'google', options:{redirectTo: NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL + '/auth/callback?next=…'}})`. **No `/auth/sign-in` route.** `/auth/sign-out` = POST form. CSP `form-action 'self'`. |
| C4 | Wrong role on `/admin/*` | **`notFound()` → root 404** for signed-in non-moderators (anon → `AdminGate` "Admins only" + Google button, HTTP 200). Never a 403 body, never a "not-allowed" gate variant. |
| C5 | Route groups | **Adopt `app/(public)/`** (Nav/Footer/FloatingSupportButton/ViewerProvider live in its layout) + `app/(onboarding)/welcome` + `app/admin/*` (own `AdminShell` layout) + `app/api/*`. Root `app/layout.tsx` = html/body/fonts/tokens only. |
| C6 | Public read of `site_settings` | **View `site_settings_public`** (`comments_closed_default`, `kofi_page`, `owner_profile_id`) readable by all; no admin-client carve-out on public pages. |
| C7 | Curation / mentions / sync role | **admin** for `curateProject`, `setProjectLink`, `triggerSync`, `uploadProjectMedia`, `create/update/fetchMention*`, `updateVideo`, `create/update Skin/Art`, exclusive-project actions. **moderator** only for comment moderation (`moderateComment`, `banUser`, `renameUserHandle`) and reading admin pages. Matches `docs/spec.md` ("mods can delete/hide comments and ban users"). RLS unchanged (admin). **[DAVID — confirmed]** |
| C8 | Skin download counter | Via `/api/download/[fileId]` with kind `skin` → RPC `record_skin_download` increments `skins.downloads`. |
| C9 | Discord recipient row | `address = <webhook URL>` (masked in UI/logs), per notifications.md. |
| C10 | `uploadProjectMedia` + `project-media` bucket | Land in **S1.3** (with the two-phase upload pattern). S1.2 gallery = Modrinth URLs only. |
| C11 | Two-phase (signed) uploads | Baseline (01 INV-51, ADR-0001 D13). **No further ADR.** Pre-assigned ADR numbers in 04 become slugs only; numbering per 06 README. |
| C12 | Analytics payloads | `download {project, source, from}` · `tip_click {amount?, from}` · `video_play {youtube_id, kind}` · `sign_in {from}`. Event names only these four in v1. |
| C13 | Hash secret | **`HASH_SECRET`** (≥32 bytes, server-only, added at S1.3) with `ipHash = HMAC-SHA256(HASH_SECRET, ip|utcDay)`; `email_hash = HMAC-SHA256(HASH_SECRET, lower(email))`. |
| C14 | Result/error shape | `ActionResult<T> = {ok:true,data:T} | {ok:false, error:{code: ActionErrorCode, message, field?, issues?}}` (types `lib/actions/result.ts`); route handlers return the same JSON on error (incl. cron 401 `{ok:false,error:{code:'unauthorized',message}}`, download 429 JSON + `Retry-After: 60`). |
| C15 | Cron `maxDuration` | 300 for sync/stats/refresh routes, 60 for `notify` (Pro plan). |
| C16 | Names/shapes | 04 wins: `<actionName>Input` schemas; `log.info/warn/error({job?|action?, id, msg, meta?})` from `lib/log.ts`; `triggerSync` in `lib/actions/admin.ts`; storage paths `avatars/{profile_id}/{hash}.webp`, `project-media/{project_id}/{icon|gallery}/{hash}.{ext}`, `project-files/{project_id}/{version_id}/{filename}`; `lib/validation/comment.ts` (`commentBodySchema, stripHtml, countLinks, linkify, commentErrorLine`); modules split per 01: `lib/validation/{handle,comment,moderation,files,slug}.ts`, `lib/files.ts` (path builders, signed URLs, `reencodeAvatar`, `resolveDownloadable`), `lib/format/*.ts`; **drop** `lib/uploads.ts`, `lib/handles.ts`, `lib/format.ts`, `lib/comments/errors.ts`. |
| C17 | Download route | GET only; HEAD/others → 405; 429 → JSON per C14. |
| C18 | `/auth/callback` | Exchange code; on error 307 `/` (no query param); then read `profiles.handle`; null → 307 `/welcome?next=`; else 307 `next` (same-origin only via `safeNext`). |
| C19 | Ko-fi | Page name from **`site_settings.kofi_page`** (view `site_settings_public`; `/support` ISR carries tag `settings`); env `KOFI_PAGE` seeds the row only. **CONTINUE ON KO-FI mounts the `KofiPanelSlot` iframe in place** (no new tab); "on Ko-fi ↗" ghost link opens the page. |
| C20 | Nav targets before their slice | **Placeholder pages** for `/projects`, `/videos`, `/skins`, `/art`, `/seen-on`, `/support` from S0 (title + one voice line "Not yet. Soon." — DESIGN.md §12.7), replaced by the real page in its slice. |
| C21 | Comment threads on skins/art/videos in v1 | **Not in v1** (projects only); schema keeps `target_type`. |
| C22 | Skin bust renderer | `skinview3d` in headless WebGL via `gl` (native dep → dependency ADR at S1.7); fallback = client render + cache on first view. |

Also: `can_comment(target_type, target_id)` SQL helper (security definer) for comment/like/report insert policies; `toggleLike` revalidates `project:<slug>`; `editComment` sets `edited_at` (no trigger); `deleteComment` may return `rate_limited`; PR template heading `## ADRs in this PR`; `design-fidelity-reviewer` references pass-3; `frontend-reviewer` INP < 200 ms; bundle delta note rule (>20 KB gz first-load → `## Bundle` line in PR).

## Consequences
- 00–05, `_registry.md`, `docs/data-model.md` (§2/§4: `rate_limit_hits`, views `comments_public`/`site_settings_public`, `comments_set_status()`, `can_comment()`, RPCs, `profiles.handle_changed_at`, `site_settings.owner_profile_id`, RLS rows), `DESIGN.md` §12.7 (build clarifications: C20 copy, chips, empty/toast/StatusPill/SyncStatus/nav metrics/VideoFacade sizes/N TOTAL/comments_closed_default label/`--ink-deep`), `docs/spec.md` (About page struck; comments v1 = projects), and the gate agents are amended in the same PR.
- Three items flagged for David (C7 roles, About page removal, `users` aggregate metric) — **all confirmed 2026-08-17**.

## Amendment A (2026-08-17) — items from the post-reconciliation gate dry-run
| # | Decision |
|---|---|
| A1 | `CommentThread` is **one client file** `components/comments/CommentThread.tsx`; `CommentList`/`CommentThread.List.tsx` do not exist (registry + 00 align). |
| A2 | Moderator view of held/reported comments in the public thread = **mods-only client read** via RPC `moderator_thread(target_type, target_id)` (security definer; requires `is_moderator()`; returns held/hidden/reported rows + `is_first_comment` + `report_count`). Allowed exception to INV-09 / 03 C-17. `comments_public` unchanged. |
| A3 | `site_settings_public` **also exposes `moderation_mode`** (non-sensitive). `postComment` reads it via the RLS server client; the client optimistic-insert rule uses it. |
| A4 | `rate_limit_ok(scope,key,max,window)` counts **only `rate_limit_hits`**; every rate-limited action records a hit; table + RPC created in S1.1. |
| A5 | T-RLS-126 and T-ACT-69 belong to the **S1.4** row. |
| A6 | Moderators may `deleteComment` on others' comments (sets `moderated_by`) — security-reviewer moderator set = `moderateComment, banUser, renameUserHandle, deleteComment(others)`. |
| A7 | New client component **`ProjectGrid`** (`components/projects/ProjectGrid.tsx`, 'use client') owns filter/search/sort state over the ISR-provided list, renders `ProjectCard`s, "Showing n of N", and the empty state; `FilterBar`/`SearchBox`/`ActiveFilterChips` are its children. Add to registry/03/02/client-island list. |
| A8 | `sync.failed`/`sync.stale` emission starts in **S1.5** (04 job preamble gets the qualifier); jobs in S1.2 log only. |
| A9 | `robots.txt` = S0 (T-E2E-45a); `sitemap.xml` = S1.2 (T-E2E-45b). |
| A10 | `TrackedLink` + Vercel Analytics custom events start in **S1.2** (`download`); `tip_click`/`sign_in`/`video_play` wired in their slices; 00 S1.2 scope updated. |
| A11 | Feature/hide/reorder controls live on `/admin/projects` (list, `ReorderableList`); `curateProject` gains a batch shape `reorder: [{project_id, featured_order}]` (one call, one revalidate); per-project extras (extra gallery, notes, CF id) on `/admin/projects/[id]`. |
| A12 | Markdown sanitisation uses **`rehype-sanitize`** (added to the INV-78 allowlist; no further ADR). |
| A13 | S0 CI `build` job uploads `build-output.txt` as an artifact; `frontend-reviewer` compares a PR's route table against `main`'s latest artifact (rule in 01 INV-10, 05 CI-4, 00 S0). |
| A14 | `HASH_SECRET` is required from **S1.1**. `email_hash` is **not** set by the DB trigger (it cannot read env); `/auth/callback` (server, service client) sets `profiles.email_hash` when null. Update 04 A3, data-model, 05 T-RLS-125/T-UNIT-23. |
| A15 | No `getSession()`. `lib/auth.ts` exports `getViewer()` (built on `getUser()`), `requireRole()`, `safeNext()`. |
| A16 | `tip_click` payload = 04 §5.6 (`{amount?: 1|3|5|'other'; from: support|tip-panel|floating}`); nav Support button is a plain link (no event). |
| A17 | Registry: `/auth/callback`, `/auth/sign-out` under `app/auth/**` (not `(public)`); add `lib/supabase/types.ts` to Modules; S1.7 depends on S1.1, S1.3. |
| A18 | `InlineConfirm` first use = S1.1 (`/profile` Delete account). |
